label: Sufficient love-compatible reason for…: GoodReason w p t is interpreted as a genuinely sufficient…
term: sufficient love-compatible reason for delaying access
definition: GoodReason w p t is interpreted as a genuinely sufficient reason compatible with perfect love for delaying immediate conscious access here. A suggested benefit, unknown reason or conceivable excuse does not establish this predicate. ReasonForEachGap is an explicit open application premise, not a definition of love and not inferred from the finite model.
note: Explicit interpretation vocabulary for #252. Source claims retain their own pinned locators; these records do not add axioms or establish the truth of the interpreted predicates.

formal_gap.meaning: Sig.GoodReason w p t says that, at world w, there is a genuinely sufficient reason, compatible with perfect love, for delaying p's immediate conscious access at time t. It is a field of the hiddenness signature (TruthCore.Hiddenness.Vocabulary.Sig, #252), indexed by world, person and time and supplied by each interpretation; worlds carry no modal accessibility laws.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: Whether such a reason exists for any actual case is exactly what the reply's open premise ReasonForEachGap asserts; no example is established.
exclusions: A suggested benefit, an unknown reason or a conceivable excuse: none establishes the predicate.
A definition of love: the predicate is used by the normative reading QualifiedOpen, not part of PerfectLove (DISAMB-HIDDENNESS-LOVE-ACCESS).
open_obligations: ReasonForEachGap is an explicit open application premise, not inferred from the finite model.
